items.front: How does cwnd grow during TCP slow start?
items.back: It starts at one segment and doubles every round trip — exponential growth.
When cwnd reaches the slow start threshold (ssthresh) or a loss occurs.

items.front: What triggers TCP Reno's fast retransmit?
items.back: Three duplicate ACKs, which suggest the network is still delivering packets; Reno resends the missing segment immediately.

items.front: What does fast recovery do to cwnd in TCP Reno after three duplicate ACKs?
items.back: It halves cwnd rather than collapsing it to one segment.

items.front: How does TCP Reno treat a timeout?
items.back: It treats it as TCP Tahoe does: ssthresh is set to half of cwnd, cwnd drops to one segment, and slow start re-enters.
